title: Score de bithérapie antiplaquettaire (DAPT)
formula:
Addition of the selected points:

| | -2 points | -1 points | 0 points | 1 point | 2 points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Age, years | ≥75 | 65-74 | <65 | -- | -- |
| Cigarette smoking* | -- | -- | No | Yes | -- |
| Diabetes mellitus | -- | -- | No | Yes | -- |
| MI at presentation | -- | -- | No | Yes | -- |
| Prior PCI or prior MI | -- | -- | No | Yes | -- |
| Paclitaxel-eluting stent | -- | -- | No | Yes | -- |
| Stent diameter <3 mm | -- | -- | No | Yes | -- |
| CHF or LVEF <30% | -- | -- | No | -- | Yes |
| Vein graft stent | -- | -- | No | -- | Yes |

*Smoking within 1 year prior to index procedure.

how_to_use.why:
- Identifie les patients qui bénéficieront probablement d'une DAPT prolongée (c.-à-d. de 12–30 mois).
- Aide à évaluer l'arbitrage entre la réduction des événements thrombotiques et l'augmentation des risques hémorragiques (prédit un bénéfice clinique net).
how_to_use.when: À utiliser chez les patients bénéficiant d'une intervention coronarienne percutanée (PCI) avec pose de stent afin de déterminer la durée optimale de la double antiagrégation plaquettaire (DAPT).
how_to_use.pearls: L’étude de dérivation n’incluait pas les patients prenant du ticagrélor ni ceux sous traitement anticoagulant.

next_steps.advice:
- Interpretation based on scores:

 - **Lower scores (<2):**

 - Associated with a greater risk in bleeding complications and smaller reduction in ischemic events.
 - Prolonged DAPT may cause greater harm than benefit.
 - **Higher scores (≥2):**

 - Associated with a lower risk in bleeding complications and higher reduction in ischemic events.
 - Prolonged DAPT may provide greater benefit than harm.
- This tool is not intended to replace clinical judgment; use it as an adjunct to clinical expertise and current cardiology guidelines.
- Inform patients about the importance of DAPT and involve them in shared decision-making based on their score.
- Schedule follow-ups to reassess DAPT needs and adjust therapy as necessary.

more_info:
Interpretation:

| DAPT Score | Ischemia/bleeding risk* | Recommendation** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| -2 to 1 | Low | Prolonged DAPT not recommended |
| ≥2 | High | Prolonged DAPT recommended |

*Ischemia was defined as MI, stroke, repeat coronary revascularization, or stent thrombosis. Bleeding was defined as intracerebral bleeding, bleeding causing hemodynamic compromise requiring treatment, or bleeding requiring transfusion.

**From ACC guidelines,[Levine 2016](https://www.onlinejacc.org/content/68/10/1082).
